overview_description.description: Alpaca is a financial technology company that provides developer-first APIs and brokerage infrastructure for programmatic access to stock, options, and cryptocurrency markets, enabling businesses and individual traders to integrate trading and investing capabilities into their applications. Its platform offers REST, WebSocket, and event-driven interfaces that support algorithmic trading, automated strategy execution, real-time market data, backtesting, and portfolio management workflows. Alpaca’s services also include brokerage account functionality, clearing and settlement services, and tools that allow firms to embed investing features into their products or to build custom trading systems on top of its API-centric architecture. The company supports global fintech partners with solutions such as tokenization, high-yield cash programs, multi-leg options trading, and advanced order types that align with diverse trading and investment use cases. Its technology is used by developers, quant traders, fintech platforms, and financial institutions seeking programmable market access and integrated financial services.

about_short_description.short_description: Alpaca is a financial system platform that allows developers and businesses to build apps, embed investing, and trade algorithms.

product.name: Broker API
product.description: An API-driven brokerage infrastructure platform for embedding stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, and investing capabilities into financial applications.

product.name: Trading API
product.description: A programmatic trading API for building, testing, and deploying automated strategies across stocks, options, and crypto through REST, streaming, and SDK integrations.

product.name: Market Data API
product.description: An API providing real-time and historical market data for stocks, ETFs, options, and cryptocurrencies to support trading, analytics, strategy development, and backtesting.

product.name: Crypto API
product.description: A developer API for cryptocurrency spot trading, crypto-to-crypto pairs, market data, and wallet deposits and withdrawals, supported by digital-asset custody infrastructure.

product.name: Self-Clearing Brokerage and Custody
product.description: Regulated brokerage infrastructure providing trade execution, clearing, settlement, custody, and operational support for Alpaca customers and institutional partners.

product.name: Tokenization Infrastructure
product.description: API-based infrastructure for platforms that issue and support trading of tokenized equities and other assets using brokerage and fractional-share capabilities.
